question: How should exact Alpaca stock and options GET responses enter the governed options engine without broadening trading authority or overstating the evidence?
assumptions: Alpaca response schemas can drift, so unknown, malformed, future-dated, or incomplete fields must fail closed or remain named skips.
Stock and options feeds have different provenance and entitlements and must remain separately labeled.
A pagination token means the observed set is incomplete and cannot be silently treated as a full option universe.
Payload hashes and endpoint references are sufficient for a local C1 receipt; raw account and market payloads do not belong in the ledger or dashboard.
No credentials, external API calls, broker orders, deployment, publication, recording upload, or submission are authorized in this work package.
options: defer normalization until the active phase
install a broad broker SDK and pass client objects through the application
pass raw Alpaca payloads into the optional AI adviser
use a strict pure normalizer over three exact read-only responses and feed only typed data into deterministic policy

facts: GET https://data.alpaca.markets/v2/stocks/{symbol}/snapshot returns the latest trade, quote, minute bar, daily bar, and previous daily bar
the stock feed is an explicit request parameter
GET https://data.alpaca.markets/v1beta1/options/snapshots/{underlying_symbol} returns option snapshots including quotes and Greeks
indicative and OPRA are distinct evidence layers
GET https://paper-api.alpaca.markets/v2/options/contracts returns contract metadata including symbol, expiration, type, strike, and open interest
the existing observer exposes only named GET methods
the governed options engine remains C1 on synthetic inputs and never sends its validated mleg payload

decision: Add the exact stock snapshot GET route, normalize stock snapshot plus contract catalog plus option chain through a pure strict bridge, retain separate feed and age fields, retain payload hashes and named skips, reject pagination and malformed required fields, and pass only typed OptionChainSnapshot data into deterministic policy.
claim_ceiling: C1 mechanics: Alpaca-shaped frozen fixtures demonstrate a redacted read-only bridge, not live connectivity, official evaluation, predictive validity, fill quality, profitability, or safety
falsifiers: A malformed or missing price, timestamp, contract identity, or metadata is silently accepted as valid evidence.
A nonempty pagination token is ignored.
Stock or options feed labels are lost or conflated.
A stale or future-dated underlying snapshot passes deterministic policy.
The normalized thesis can pass with fewer than the frozen source-reference floor.
The frozen Alpaca-shaped fixture bridge cannot reproduce the governed one-contract PASS path with a recomputed 20 dollar maximum loss.
Raw payloads, credentials, account identifiers, or secret headers enter a receipt, ledger, dashboard, test artifact, or repository file.
negative_controls: malformed option quote retained as a named skip
nonready account receipt cannot become AccountState
stop_rule: Stop when frozen Alpaca-shaped fixtures normalize through the exact GET observer into the governed engine, feed and freshness controls pass, pagination and malformed-input controls fail closed, the dashboard and runbook show the bridge without raw data, and the full verifier returns zero regressions.
